messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: trigger updates
parts:
There are two problems with doing a (potentially) long-running, periodically scheduled task directly in an R Shiny app.

1) There is no guarantee that your Shiny app will be running all the time; by default, the Shiny Server application server shuts down R processes that are not being used.

2) R is single threaded, so while this scraping is being done, no other work can be done in that R process.

Ideally you would move the job into a separate R script, and have that script scheduled to run periodically. I don't think this is supported by ShinyApps.io at this time though.

Shiny does let you run scheduled tasks using time-based reactive primitives like invalidateLater, reactiveTimer, and reactivePoll. However, because of the above reasons, these are best suited for tasks that only need to run while the app itself is running, and can complete their task in a relatively small amount of time.
